answer: The basalt explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Splitting into 6 separate vaults needs a separate funded prism account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the dune binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 190 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
